interpretation: In this run Luna was faster and passed all fixed scenarios at first submission. No evidence that adding Harness exceeded the standalone model result.
Both model and workflow changed, so this is not a causal estimate of Harness benefit or a general ranking of Luna versus Gemini.

The observed missed behavior is a coverage/candidate-code problem: the six public tests omitted a case in the 36-scenario external suite. Harness accurately recorded its limited checks, while the model overclaimed full completion.
The original passing snapshot was not silently reused for changed files: workspace equality became false; the replacement Run remains visibly unmeasured.
Final repaired code passed external grading, but do not present that as completed Harness re-verification. The active Run was left intact, with no automatic finish or further provider call.
One task/repetition with internally authored reference outputs and defect controls is not proof of a model ceiling or universal correctness.
